clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Puck is dropped! We are underway!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Welcome to a huge night on the ice! Blue versus Red, let's go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Faceoff win! Clean draw back to the point!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, the energy in this arena is electric!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: They win the draw and they're off!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Quick hands on that faceoff! Brilliant!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Tape to tape! Beautiful pass!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Drop pass, and they're flying up the ice!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What vision! He threaded that through three sticks!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Cross-ice feed! Here comes the chance!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Stretch pass to center! Breakaway brewing!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He's flying through the neutral zone!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What speed! He blows past the defender!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Look at those edges! He skates like the wind!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Toe drag! Oh, what a move!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The hands on this kid! Absolutely silky!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He winds up! Slapshot!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Big blast from the point!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Booming slapshot! What a rocket!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: You could hear that one from the top row!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Quick wrist shot!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Snaps it on goal!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Wrister off the rush!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Great release! Hardly any warning!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Save! Glove hand!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Kicked away by the pad!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goalie stops it and covers up!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Solid positioning! He made that look easy!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Blocker save! Steered into the corner!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a save! He robbed him!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Glove save! Snatched out of the air!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Diving across the crease! Unbelievable!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That goalie is a brick wall tonight!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, highlight reel save! Absolutely stunning!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Off the post! Oh, so close!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Just wide! Inches away!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Ooh, he had half the net to shoot at!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Rings off the crossbar!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Big hit along the boards! Clean check!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Oh, he lays him out! Huge hit!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Shoulder to shoulder, perfectly clean! The crowd loves it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Thunderous check at center ice!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He scores! He scores!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goal! Top shelf!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: It's in! Past the goalie!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goal for Blue! The horn is blaring!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goal for Red! Red fans are going crazy!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Five hole! He scores!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a finish! Picked the corner!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, that is pure skill! What a goal!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He shoots, he scores! Gooooooaaaal!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Top shelf, where mama hides the cookies! Gooooaaal!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: They're going on the power play!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Power play time! Man advantage!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: This is a big chance! They have to make it count!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Power play goal! They cash in!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Penalty killed off! Great work by the defense!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: To the penalty box for two minutes!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Tripping call! He's going to sit!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That was a lazy stick! He has to be smarter there!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Hooking! Two minutes in the box!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Icing! The whistle goes!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Tired legs! They just needed a change!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Icing is called! Back for a faceoff!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Offside! Stopped at the blue line!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: So close! Just a step too early!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The players exchange a fist bump! Great sportsmanship!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Hard battles, but total respect! That's what we love!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Everybody skates back! Let's keep it clean and fast!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: That's the end of the first period!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The buzzer sounds! End of the second!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a period! Non-stop action!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: We're back for the next period!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: We're going to overtime!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Sudden death! Next goal wins it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Overtime goal! They win it! Unbelievable!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, what a way to end it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: It's coming down to a shootout!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Here he comes, one on one!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Shootout goal! Deke and score!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Stopped! The goalie wins the battle!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Ice cold! Nerves of steel!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: That's the final buzzer! They win it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Victory! What a performance on the ice!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Final buzzer, and it's a tough loss tonight!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They gave it everything! What a game!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They deserved that! Brilliant from start to finish!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a comeback! Down two, now in front!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Never give up! That's heart right there!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Listen to this arena! It's deafening!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The fans are banging on the glass!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Everybody is on their feet!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What an atmosphere tonight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Battle along the boards for the puck!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They're cycling it low, waiting for an opening!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Line change on the fly!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: You can feel a goal coming!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Plenty of hockey left!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a start from Blue!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They came out flying! Their legs look fresh!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is the goalie unbeatable tonight?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's seeing everything! What a performance!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Big power play coming up!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They've got to get pucks on net!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Did you see those hands?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Unreal! The defender didn't stand a chance!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: This arena is rocking!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They're the sixth skater tonight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Can they kill this penalty?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They'll have to block shots and stay disciplined!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Huge clean hit there!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Perfectly timed! That's hockey!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The puck just won't go in!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Keep shooting! It's going to bounce their way!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: They're pulling the goalie!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: All in! Extra skater, let's go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a pass across the crease!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Pure vision! He sees plays before they happen!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Overtime! Here we go!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Anything can happen! One shot, game over!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: They need a goal, and fast!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Get bodies in front of the net!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Breakaway chance!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's got speed! Can he finish?

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Blue are all over them!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Red can't get out of their own zone!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Lovely sportsmanship there!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That's what this game is all about!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is this the game of the year?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: It's right up there! What a show!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Another shot off the post!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The posts are on the goalie's side tonight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The pace is frantic!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: End to end! Nobody's catching their breath!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: That slapshot was a rocket!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He nearly put it through the net!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: And that's the final buzzer!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a game! I loved every shift!
